ctu1.sentence: The implementing authority for the Infrastructure Subsidy scheme is the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME).

ctu2.sentence: Entrepreneurs can contact these institutes for assistance with the application process and to seek guidance on project development.
